create.name: Kathie and Paul Scott
create.bio:
Kathie and Paul Scott are a married couple who run Quantum Life, a shared energy-healing practice in Vancouver, British Columbia. They have taught Quantum-Touch together since 2011, a method that pairs focused breathing and intention with light touch to work with life-force energy, and by their own count they have now led close to two hundred workshops, in Canada and also in Bali, the United States, Mexico and Spain. Kathie teaches all four levels of the Quantum-Touch programme. Paul brings training in conscious-connected breathwork, Matrix Energetics, family constellations and metaphysical ministry, and he gives the couple's one-to-one sessions.

Breath sits at the centre of their work. Their signature practice, Anahata, is a guided breath meditation that moves through twelve chakras, built from a chakra and breath method learned at the Oneness University in India and the twelve-chakra map used in Quantum-Touch. They lead it each month as a ceremonial cacao gathering in Vancouver, where cacao is optional, and twice a year as a seven-day online immersion. Their Quantum-Touch workshops run in person and online, and on the third Wednesday of each month they host a free circle on Zoom where past students practise giving and receiving the method together.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Workshops, Levels 1 to 4
courses.description: Weekend Quantum-Touch workshops taught by Kathie and Paul, in person and online, on a repeating yearly calendar. Level 1, Becoming Energized, is the starting point and the only prerequisite for Level 2 (Becoming SuperCharged), Level 3 (Becoming Whole) and Level 4 (Becoming Heart-Conscious), which go deeper into breath, visualisation, the twelve-chakra system and working at a distance.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Paul Scott
courses.description: One-to-one energy sessions with Paul, in person in Vancouver or over Zoom or FaceTime. He draws on Quantum-Touch alongside his breathwork and other energy training.
courses.price: Initial Session - $300 + 5% GST; Repeat Session - $150 Per Hour + 5% GST

courses.title: Anahata Cacao Journeys in Vancouver
courses.description: A monthly evening gathering in Vancouver that opens with a sharing circle, then a cup of ceremonial cacao and the couple's hour-long Anahata twelve-chakra breath meditation. Groups of friends or colleagues can also book a private journey.

courses.title: Anahata 7-Day Deep Dive (online)
courses.description: A seven-day live online immersion built around the Anahata twelve-chakra breathwork, with a focus on one chakra at a time and added breathwork processes; cacao is optional. The next round runs in January 2027.

free_resources.title: Quantum Life Circle (monthly, online)
free_resources.description: A free two-hour circle on Zoom on the third Wednesday of each month, hosted by Kathie and Paul. It opens with a short meditation, then everyone gives and receives Quantum-Touch, and it ends with sharing. Past students of any Quantum-Touch instructor are welcome once they have completed the first level.
